picked_rationale.C2: C2 is the causal behavioral apex of the research direction — the headline mechanistic result that amplifying the helix-selective SAE subspace RAISES predicted %-helix. C1 (features are selective) is its precondition and C3 (dose-response shape) is a corollary; both are only interesting because C2 holds. The two prescribed swaps (steering-direction method swap; SS-readout-tool dataset swap) directly stress the two things C2 could be an artifact of.
